identification: Ganges, rising on the southern slopes of the Himalaya and flowing through India and Bangladesh to the Bay of Bengal
quote: 殑伽河:卽恒河,殑伽,梵文 Gangā 音譯…恒河實源出今喜馬拉雅山南麓,流經印度,孟加拉國,注入

identification: Indus, rising at the W foot of the Gangdisê (Kailas) range in Tibet and flowing through India and Pakistan to the Arabian Sea
quote: 信度河:即印度河,梵文 Sindhu 音譯…源出我國西藏岡底斯山西麓,經印

name_in_source: Old Iran. Waxšu; Ind. Čaksu, Sučaksu, Wankşu; Gk. Oxus
identification: the Oxus; Ji equates it with the Vakhsh river and says that, strictly, it should be distinguished from the Amu Darya (formed by the Panj and the Vakhsh)
quote: 古伊朗作 Waxšu, 印度誤Čaksu,Sučaksu…為希臘語 Oxus 之對音,今瓦赫什河(Vaksa R.)…嚴格說來,芻河與阿姆河有區別
note: differs slightly from Mizutani (Amu Darya): Ji narrows 縛芻 to the Vakhsh

identification: Yarkand river and Tarim river
quote: 梵語 Sita 音譯,又譯作私陀、私多,今葉爾羌河與塔里木河
note: Mizutani: Yarkand river only; Ji adds the Tarim

identification: the Pamirs (葱嶺) are the more likely referent
others_reported: old view: Kunlun; Mizutani: N shore of Lake Mānasa in the Himalaya
quote: 香山:梵文 Gandhagiri 的意譯…舊說指崑崙山,似以葱嶺(帕米爾高原)爲當。水谷真成注指喜馬拉雅山中 mānasa 湖北岸
note: differs from Mizutani (Pamirs rather than Kailāsa / Mānasa)

identification: no location for Jishi; Ji only says the real Yellow River source is in the Bayan Har range, Qinghai, and that the Jishi account follows an erroneous old view
quote: 黄河源出青海省巴顏喀拉山脉…潛行地下,南出積石”的舊說,這是錯誤的
note: Mizutani: Amne Machin; Ji does not locate the mountain

identification: the Hindu Kush; alternatively a general name for the snowless dark southern ranges seen from India
quote: 堀謙德《解說西域記》頁31謂“卽波斯語 Siyahkoh 山脉”,案卽今興都庫什山
note: differs from Mizutani (E-W range across central Afghanistan) and from Ji's own note at 迦畢試 (see 01.37.03a)

identification: old Gaochang city, ruins c. 60 li SE of Turfan county; the district is now Qara-hoja, the city Idiqut-shähri
others_reported: Pelliot (name); Ouyang Xuan (Yuan: 哈喇和綽 = 高昌)
quote: 遺址在今我國新疆維吾爾自治區吐魯番縣東南六十餘里

identification: Yanqi (Karashahr) Hui autonomous county; E border at Yushugou, SW through the Tieguan valley to Korla
others_reported: Henning: 烏夷 = Argi/Arki; Huang Wenbi (1958): borders
quote: 阿耆尼為梵文 Agni(意為“火”)的譯音。今新疆維吾爾自治區焉耆回族自治縣
note: post-1971: Geng Shimin and Zhang Guangda, 唆里迷考, 歷史研究 1980 (Solmi name); agrees with Mizutani

identification: no preference: reports Stein (Bagdad-shahr S of Yanqi) and Huang Wenbi (Tang capital 4 li E of 四十里城子, Yanqi county)
others_reported: Stein: Bagdad-shahr; Huang Wenbi: 4 li E of 四十里城子
quote: 據斯坦因稱爲今焉耆南之…據黃文弼稱,唐代焉耆都城在今焉耆縣四十里城子東四里
note: adds Huang Wenbi's site (1958) to Mizutani's Stein

identification: Kucha county, Aksu prefecture; capital (Han 延城, Tang 伊邏廬城) probably the 皮郎 old city near Kucha
quote: 卽今我國新疆維吾爾自治區阿克蘇專區庫車…似為庫車附近之皮郎舊城
note: agrees with Mizutani; capital site not in Mizutani

identification: ruins on both banks of the 銅廠河 at Subashi, N of Kucha
quote: 遺址在今庫車北蘇巴什地方銅廠河兩岸

identification: Douldour-agour, across the Kumtura river W of Kucha
quote: 爲其遺址在今庫車西部庫木土拉河對岸的 Douldour-agour 地方

identification: Aksu; the capital most probably at Wensu county (old Aksu town)
others_reported: Feng Chengjun: Wensu; Huang Wenbi: Halabake; Xiyu tuzhi: Yaha-arik; Li Guangting: Kara-yulgun; Ding Qian: Baicheng
quote: 義云“沙”,卽今阿克蘇…都城在今温宿縣的說法較有根據
note: Mizutani leaves the capital undecided; Ji favours Wensu

identification: the Muzart ice pass between Ili and Wensu, or the Bedel pass; scholars undecided
others_reported: some: Bedel pass (勃達嶺 of Du Huan, 拔達嶺 of Xin Tangshu)
quote: 突厥語作兹阿特或木扎特…的凌山,究竟何指,現學者之間尚無一致意見

identification: Issyk-kul lake
quote: 熱海,突厥語作 Issyk-kul,今譯伊塞克湖

identification: Ak-Beshim, 8 km SW of Tokmak
others_reported: Clauson (1961), Klyashtornyi (克里亞施托爾內), Mori Masao: Ak-Beshim
quote: 碎葉故址當在托克瑪克城西南八公里處之阿克-貝西姆
note: post-1971: 護雅夫 古代遊牧帝國 (1976); 張廣達 碎葉考 (1979); agrees with Mizutani, more precise

name_in_source: Pahl. Sülik (Marquart); Sulya (Bailey); Sogd. Sγwδyk; Gk. Sogdiana
identification: Sogdiana; Xuanzang's wide extent (Suyab to Kesh) reflects older usage, the Muslim-period Sughd being much narrower
quote: 此名均卽《北史》卷九七《西域傳》中之粟特(Soghdiana)…反映了如下一個事實:穆斯林時期的窣利之範圍遠比古代的狹窄
note: Mizutani explains the NE extension by Sogdian colonies; Ji by older wider usage

identification: no modern site; cites Ibn Khurdādhbih's hill ringed by a thousand springs at Abārjāj between Isbījāb and Ṭarāz
quote: 屏聿當是 Bing-yul 的對音…記載白水城與怛邏私之間阿巴爾扎只(Abārjāj)之地有丘岡
note: Mizutani's Merke not mentioned; Ibn Khurdādhbih's place lies W of Ṭarāz, whereas the text puts 千泉 E of it

identification: Dzhambul (formerly Aulie-Ata), Kazakhstan, partly built over the old city; the present Talas town is 80 km ESE
quote: 呾邏私故址在今蘇聯哈薩克斯坦的江布爾城…爾的部分城區建立在原呾邏私城部分遺址之上

identification: no location; comments only on the Chinese captives of the Turks (Zizhi tongjian, 631)
quote: 在呾邏私城南之小孤城居住之中國人,未詳何時移居此地

identification: Sayram, c. 15 km E of Chimkent, N bank of the Aris
quote: 位於今 Chimkent 以東約十五公里處,今其地仍然叫做 Sayram
note: post-1971: Belenitskii et al., Srednevekovyi gorod Srednei Azii (1973); agrees with Mizutani

identification: one of the c. 40 towns of the Chach-Ilak district (Chirchik and Angren basins); excavation has not fixed it
quote: 恭御城當在阿拉伯地理學家所說的“察赤—伊拉克”(Chach-Ilak)地區之内…但發掘的成績還不足以確定恭城的方位
note: post-1971: Belenitskii et al. 1973; Mizutani: not identifiable; Ji narrows to a district

name_in_source: Nujakath, Nujikath, Nujkath 'new town'; Xin Tangshu 弩室羯
identification: Khanabad in the Tashkent region
quote: 皆爲Nujakath Nujikath 或 Nujkath之對音…蘇聯考古學者根據發掘情況,將此城比定爲今塔什干地區的汗阿巴德
note: post-1971: Belenitskii et al. 1973; differs from Mizutani (Chichik / Kosh-kurgan)

name_in_source: Sogd. C'c; Pers. Chach; Ar. Shash 'stone'
identification: Tashkent region (Chirchik basin); the old Chach town at Binkath near the Chirchik
quote: 此為今塔什干附近的中亞地區名及大城名…當在距離今天 Chirchik 河不遠的Binkath
note: post-1971: Belenitskii et al. 1973 (plan of Binkath); agrees with Mizutani, adds Binkath

name_in_source: Pahl. *jaxšarta (Marquart); Gk. Iaxartes; Turk. Yänčü ügüz
identification: the Jaxartes (Syr Darya)
quote: 藥殺水當是中世波斯語(Pahlavi)*jaxšarta…此當爲斯特拉波(Strabo)《地理志》(VII)之Iaxartes/Yaxartes

identification: Ferghana basin on the upper Syr Darya, between the Chatkal and Alai ranges
quote: 今中亞費爾納(Farghana)地區,位於錫爾河上游

identification: Usrūshana, S of the Syr Darya at the W outlet of Ferghana, between the Hissar and Zarafshan ranges; chief town Bunjikath, which Ji equates with Panjikent 60 km E of Samarkand
others_reported: Minorsky: read Sutrūshana; Barthold: old town at Ura-Tübe
quote: 窣堵利瑟那境内大城為 Bunjikath (半制城),今名旁吉肯特…巴托爾德認為古城在 Ura-Tübe
note: differs from Mizutani (Shahristan or Ura-tyube): Ji's Bunjikath = Panjikent is a confusion; cites recent Panjikent finds (paintings)

identification: Samarkand: the Afrasiab plateau 3.5 km N of present Samarkand
quote: 故址在今中亞撒馬爾罕以北3.5公里處之一高地上,本名 Afrasiab

identification: the Afrasiab site, 3.5 km N of present Samarkand (c. 219 ha)
quote: 故址在今中亞撒馬爾罕以北3.5公里處之一高地上,本名 Afrasiab

identification: SW of Samarkand, a station from Nasaf on the Bukhara-Nasaf road; exact site not fixed
quote: 學者多比定之為現今的Čuma'abazar…其在颯秣建之西南殆無疑義
note: differs from Mizutani (SE of Samarkand); Ji also argues 弭秣賀 to 貨利習彌伽 were hearsay and Xuanzang went straight from Samarkand to Kesh

identification: general position from its royal seat Ishtikhan (W, N of Samarkand) and the town Kabudhanjkat 2 farsakh E of Samarkand
quote: 劫布呾那王治瑟底痕城,當是穆斯林地理文獻中…根據瑟底痕及劫布呾那兩城之位置,可以推知劫布呾那國的大致方位

identification: Kushāniya, 'the heart of Sughd'
quote: 乃梵語化詞Kusānika、中世波斯語…阿拉伯語 Kušāniyya
note: no position given; agrees with Mizutani

identification: N bank of the Zarafshan facing Karminiya (c. 6 km), later Kalkan-ata
quote: 此 Kharghānkath 位於那密水(今澤拉夫善河)之北,河之南爲 Karminiya 城

identification: Bukhara
quote: 皆 Bukhārā 之對音…考 Bukhärā 初建時城名Numijkath

name_in_source: Betik, Bitik (Feng Chengjun, Hori, after Julien)
identification: Bitik village on the Amu Darya facing Amol/Charjui, c. 400 li SW of Bukhara
quote: rab 兩村現仍存在於阿姆河岸,與今 Amol/Charjui 城遥遥相對…當以 Betik 說為是
note: agrees with Mizutani (near Chardzhou), more definite

identification: Khwarizm, both banks of the lower Amu Darya
quote: 貨利習彌伽國:在阿姆河下游兩岸地區

identification: Kesh = Shahr-i Sabz, 75 km S of Samarkand
quote: 城址在颯秣建(撒馬爾罕)南七十五公里處

name_in_source: Turk. Tämir Qapïɣ; Pers. Dar-i Āhanīn; Ar. Bāb al-ḥadīd
identification: the Buzgala defile in the Baysun-tau, 90 km S of Shahr-i Sabz, c. 3 km long

identification: the former Tukhāra land under the Western Turkish yabghu; Xuanzang describes 29 states in it (16 in juan 1, 13 in juan 12)
quote: 玄奘所見之覩貨邏國,當指臣服於西突厥阿史那氏葉護可汗的吐火羅國

identification: Termez: old town on the Amu Darya near the mouth of the Surkhan; the present town is the third site
quote: 位於 Surkhan 河注入阿姆河河口不遠處…1964-1966年考古發掘證實
note: 1964-66 excavations (Greek fort, Kushan stupa, Kara-Tepe cave monastery, Brahmi/Kharosthi sherds); post-1971: Knobloch, Beyond the Oxus (1972); agrees with Mizutani

identification: upper Surkhan: Dih-i nau = Denau
quote: 此地當 Surkhan河上游,今名Dih-i nau=Denau

identification: near Dushanbe
quote: 馬迦特與沙畹(Chavannes)皆比定爲Kharûn…參看愉漫條。其地當在今杜尚别附近

identification: upper Kafirnihan, near Dushanbe
quote: 其地當在Kafirnihān 河上游,故址在今杜尚别附近
note: post-1971: Belenitskii et al. 1973; agrees with Mizutani

identification: Qobadian on the lower Kafirnihan E of Termez (renamed Mikoyanabad); the 3rd-4th c. layer probably the town Xuanzang saw
quote: 故址在呾蜜(Tirmidh)之東,Kafirnihān 河下游之 Qobadian…這大概是玄奘所見鞠和衍那/久越得健的故址
note: Soviet excavations since the 1950s (Qobadian I-IV); post-1971: Stavisky, Kushanskaya Baktriya (1977); agrees with Mizutani

identification: Lāwakand on the Wakhsh, 10 km W of Kurgan-Tübe, perhaps Kaun-Tepe
quote: 其地當在 Wakhsh 水或Surkhab 水上之 Lāwakand…在今 Kurgan-Tübe 以西十公里處,可能是 Kaun-Tepe
note: post-1971: Belenitskii et al. 1973; differs from Mizutani (Halāward) on the town

identification: between the Wakhsh/Surkhab and the Panj; chief town Kulab, 125 km SE of Dushanbe
quote: Wakhsh/Surkhab 河以東至 Panj河之地。其主城在今杜尚别市東南125公里之 Kulab
note: differs from Mizutani on the capital (Hulbuk)

identification: the Kumedh people/name only; no location
quote: 按:Kumedh 無疑是托勒密之 Komidai
note: Mizutani: Darwaz; Ji gives no location

identification: at the confluence of the Doshi and Talaqan rivers, near Kunduz
quote: 其地在Doshi 河與 Talaqān 河匯合處,今昆都士(Qunduz)附近
note: note in Ji's juan 12; cites Kyoto Univ. work on its monasteries (Mizuno); agrees with Mizutani

identification: middle Doshi river, c. 60 km SW of Kunduz
quote: 其地位於阿姆河以南之 Doshi 河中游,今Kunduz 西南約60公里

identification: two places counted as one country: Rub (now Rui) and Simingān; Haibak in the Khulm valley
others_reported: Marquart; Moorcroft: Haibak; Yule: Rub = Rui
quote: 馬迦特認為玄奘記載之紇露悉泯健當是兩地…比定爲 Khulm 河流域之Haibak

identification: ruins on the N outskirts of Tash-Qurghan
quote: 此卽 Khulm。其遺址在今阿富汗境内的Tash-Qurghān 北郊

identification: Balkh: the Bala Hissar ruins (c. 150 ha), 23 km W of Mazar-i Sharif
others_reported: Marquart; Schlumberger (1949); Uchida Gimpū: 拔底延 = Patiyan 'royal city'
quote: 其故址在今阿富汗境内 Mazār-i-Sharif 以西23 公里處,主要廢墟名 Bala-Hissar

identification: the Nau-Vihār of the Arab geographers; no site named
quote: 阿拉伯地理書稱這一寺院為 Nau-Vihār
note: Ji does not give Mizutani's / Foucher's Top-i-Rustam

identification: not real towns: two merchants' names taken as place names; no location
quote: 提謂城、波利城:這是以人名訛為地名…據比爾(S.Beal)云在 Rāngun 地方

identification: S of the Oxus at the foot of the Hindu Kush; site undetermined
quote: 馬迦特認為銳秣陁爲 Zumathān 之對音…見馬迦特《伊蘭考》頁227。方位待考
note: differs from Mizutani (Sar-i-pul): Ji leaves it open

identification: a district (not a town) between Merv and Balkh, drained by the Āb-i Qaysār and Āb-i Safīd
quote: 胡健位於木鹿/馬里(Muru/Merv)與縛喝/巴里黑之間

identification: Talaqan 65 km E of Kunduz
quote: 此地位於Kunduz以東的65公里處

identification: some put it at Darrah Gaz; no firm evidence

quote: 或云在今阿富汗之達拉哈斯(Darrah Gaz);此地何在,目前尚缺乏有力的考証依據

identification: Bamiyan town, c. 150 miles W of Kabul
quote: 其國都則爲今阿富汗首都喀布爾西部約一百五十英里的巴米揚(Bāmiyān)城

identification: the 53 m standing Buddha at Bamiyan
quote: 立佛像高五十三米,今猶存

identification: the 35 m Buddha, 400 m from the 53 m Buddha (鍮石 = a brass coating)
quote: 鑰石釋迦佛,今仍在,高三十五米,與立佛像相距四百米

identification: the E-W range across central Afghanistan joining the Hindu Kush to the NE; boundary between India and the Hu
quote: 卽在阿富汗中部東西走向的山脉,東北連興都庫什山,疑為希臘文獻的 Paropamisoa
note: note at 迦畢試 (三陲黑嶺); agrees with Mizutani; differs from Ji's own note at 01.04a (Hindu Kush)

name_in_source: Kapiśi; Kapiśa-Kapis; Kavişiye nagara (coin of Eucratides)
identification: Begram (Bagh-i-Alam), 62 km N of Kabul, Kanishka's summer capital
quote: 其地在今阿富汗境内之 Begram…此地發掘工作由法國、日本繼續到七十年代

identification: Begram, 62 km N of Kabul
quote: Begram 位於喀布爾以北62公里
note: from the country note; agrees with Mizutani

name_in_source: 沙落迦 (Life) = Saraγ 'Luoyang' (Xiang Da, after Pelliot)

identification: SE of Begram; no ruin named
quote: 此伽藍的遺址在 Begram 的東南地方

identification: probably a NW Prakrit name; the site c. 12 km S of Begram, ruins extant (after Mizutani)
others_reported: Julien; St Martin; Watters; Mizutani (1971): 12 km S of Begram
quote: 水谷真成贊同瓦特斯的意見,并指出該城在今阿富汗東南Begram 南約十二公里處,遺址尚存

identification: (after B.C. Law) a mountain W of the Kailāsa range, which parallels the Ladakh range

note: post-1971: B.C. Law, Historical Geography of Ancient India (1976); Mizutani gives no location; Law's Himalayan mountain does not fit the text (30 li S of the shrine near Begram)

name_zh: 大雪山 (龍池・迦膩色迦王伽藍)

others_reported: Hori: the dragon = a hill people; Mizutani (1971)

identification: the 100 x 200 m mud-brick enclosure at the N end of the Begram town site

name_in_source: Madhyadeśa, Udīcya / Uttarāpatha, Prācya, Dakṣiṇāpatha, Aparānta

name_in_source: Skt. Lampāka; Lampa / Lumba (Watters); Ptolemy Lambatai; Babur Lamghanat

quote: 今名 Laghmān,在喀布爾河北岸,東西以 Alingar 及 Kunar 河為界
